intro: Quiet Evidence: Unravel deep mysteries, spot hidden clues, find the truth.
description:
Quiet Evidence is an immersive, story-driven investigation game for mystery and puzzle enthusiasts. Test your keen observation, logic, and deduction skills as you unravel the dark secrets behind Maddy, a young girl who has suddenly vanished without a trace.

Whether you approach the case through the emotional lens of a desperate father or the cold logic of an experienced detective, Quiet Evidence delivers a perfectly balanced, suspenseful atmosphere by letting you experience two distinct perspectives.

Navigate this dark world at your own pace, where no obvious path is laid out for you. Explore detailed environments, examine objects, and solve deep, contextual puzzles. Remember: a misplaced item or a missed inconsistency could change the entire course of the investigation.

Get ready to unlock your full potential, spot the silent evidence others miss, and bring the shocking truth to light.
